g.text: Short-term sample agreement does not guarantee long-term stability
Same nominal reset: Z100, auxiliary fan on 60 s / off 300 s. Bed 60 deg C; nozzle 140 deg C. One run per wait.
XY remained fixed; omitted travel was simulated with dwells. Host logging extended each scan to about 440 s.
